message:
Only bankrupts left: the spinner bankrupts another team

When every remaining wedge is BANKRUPT, the buzz hits the other team
(2 teams) or a team the spinner picks (3+). A pulsing banner on both
screens names who is spinning to bankrupt whom.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Steal is automatic with 2 teams; picker only at 3+

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Kingdom Spin: wheel-based sibling of Kingdom Clash

Single-file game: SVG wheel that spins at constant speed until a USB
buzzer (types "1") stops it instantly, shatters the landed wedge, and
animates the survivors to fill 360. Operator + ?present windows sync via
spin events (BroadcastChannel + localStorage + polling), not frames.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
